title: The Morning Digest: October 15, 2026
dek: A Singapore-registered container ship struck on Tuesday has sunk in the Strait of Hormuz, a second Singapore container ship was damaged on Wednesday, and a bulk carrier struck on September 23 has also sunk. Security data show at least 10 vessels attacked since Sunday and 23 attacks since October 1, the highest tempo of the war. Crude fell more than $1 overnight anyway, as the United States considers easing sanctions on shadow-fleet vessels to cut shipping costs and the IEA reported Gulf crude exports recovering to about 75 percent of prewar levels in September. The diesel crack eased about $10 to $102.05, a ninth straight day above $100. The Kremlin said the energy ceasefire terms have not been established, and Ukraine said it will resume strikes on Russian refineries. No Russian diesel cargo has loaded. Canadian December widened: WCS Dec26 settled at -$26.25.
